website.how: The site is titled "Sarah McBride for Congress | Official Campaign Website" and says she represents Delaware's at-large congressional district.
The site is titled "Dr. Joe For Congress — Delaware 2026", is paid for by "Citizens for Joe Arminio" and speaks of Delaware's 2026 General Election.
The site is titled "Dr. Mike Katz for U.S. Senate — Delaware 2026".

offices.source: His campaign site lists "Delaware State Senate" under his time as a legislator; it gives no years and does not say whether the service is past or present

offices.office: State Senator, Delaware State Senate, 4th district
offices.source: Wikipedia, "Michael Katz (politician)": member of the Delaware Senate from the 4th district, 2009 to 2013, with a footnote; the article ties him to the 2026 Republican U.S. Senate nomination in Delaware. Years still deserve an official check (legis.delaware.gov and elections.delaware.gov were out of reach from this machine).
